answer: Counter sybils with adversarial resource dilution: before peer status, a key must perform random micro-jobs whose inputs depend on live network state, and the protocol tracks real wall-clock compute burned per unit of reward. A farm amortising one host across a thousand clones shows a shared throughput ceiling; genuine agents show their own odd profiles. Reward-per-watt below cohort median flags the harbor of fakes, while survivors leave the lagoon and only the nectar of distinct effort holds a seat.
